site: Workday (Marathon Petroleum Create Account form; any credential form with a disclosure button)
class: A closed vocabulary of harmless button labels decided whether a credential form could be authorised, so a harmless label outside the list blocked the whole form
symptom: After the posting was opened, the run stopped at Create Account: 'the account-creation click could not be confirmed; check the page before trying again'.
root_cause: The guard authorises an account-creation click only when every other button in the form is a known non-final label. Marathon's form has a 'Read More' button (expands the consent text), which was not on the list ('Show More' was), so the click was never authorised.
why_tests_missed: Every credential-form fixture contained only the fields and the one Create Account button; none had a disclosure button like the real form.
fix: read more / read less / learn more / see more / see less are known non-final utility labels (safety.SAFE_UTILITY_LABEL_RE). An unknown action button such as 'Confirm & Send' still blocks authorisation.
prevention: Test the guard against a copy of each real portal's form, not a minimal one; keep the label list fail-closed so an unrecognised button blocks rather than passes.
